This '''Padawan''' was with the [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]] during the events of [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]]. When Drallig confronted [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] alias of the fallen Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], he and his Padawan dueled Vader. The Padawan fought Vader, with Drallig then using some of his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] to ensure the Padawan did not end up killed by Vader. After three instances of this, Drallig ordered the Padawan to retreat from the duel.
